description: Show who is connected: name and email of the account and the company (id, name, employee count) that all other tools act on. Use it to check the API key works or to confirm the company before creating anything. Read-only. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.
name: safe_mind_me
